days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 130 ? push day wasn't logged this week. No data means no progression, no bump, nothing. Two weeks of this and we'd be having a different conversation. Show up Monday, hit all three sets at 10 reps at RPE 7 or under, and you earn 135. Touch the chest, brief pause, drive through the heels. Big breath before you unrack, stay braced the whole set. The weight is right ? just need the log.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 45 ? push day not logged, so no update here either. Last confirmed data was 8/10/10. Set 1 is still the weak link ? figure out what's different in your setup before the first rep, not after. Take the full 90 seconds after bench. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45 degrees off the torso, control the negative. Need 10/10/10 to earn 50.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? push day wasn't logged. Last confirmed data was 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/9. The reps are there but set 3 is still costing you an RPE 9. Need all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 35. Don't grind sets 1 and 2 harder than you need to ? press straight up, full lockout, no lean back. Pace yourself early and set 3 takes care of itself.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Staying at 15 ? push day not logged. Last confirmed: 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 at 15 lbs. Reps are not at the top of the range yet and RPE is sitting at 8. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 or under to earn 20. Slight elbow bend, lead with the elbow, 2-second hold at the top, slow the negative. Don't swing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Flyes
exercises.notes: Staying at 20 ? push day wasn't logged so we have no data from last week. This is the second week dumbbell flyes are in the rotation. Treat it like it's still a baseline week: slight bend in the elbows, lower in a wide arc until you feel the full stretch across the chest, squeeze at the top. Aim for 10-12 at RPE 7. Log all three sets with weight and RPE ? need the data to move this forward.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Rope Extension
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? replacing tricep rope pushdown this week. Pushdown has been in rotation for several weeks; switching to overhead rope extension to hit the long head of the triceps through a fuller stretch. Face away from the pulley, rope overhead, elbows pointing at the ceiling, extend fully and squeeze at the top ? the stretch at the bottom is the whole point of this variation. Start at 30 lbs, baseline week. Aim for 10-12 at RPE 7. Log all three sets.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: UP to 195 ? you hit 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7 two weeks in a row now. That's exactly what we were waiting for. Last week was the confirmation session ? it wasn't a fluke. You earned this bump. Lats tight from the floor, bar dragging up the shins, breathing reset between every rep. This is a 10 lb jump so expect it to feel heavier than 185 did by the third set. If RPE climbs above 8 on set 3, note it ? that's the data point that tells us how long we stay here.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? you jumped to 60 lbs last week (not the prescribed weight) and went 10/8/8 at RPE 7/8/8. Set 1 was great but sets 2 and 3 dropped reps and climbed RPE. Good initiative grabbing the heavier pair, but the weight outran your consistency. Dropping back to 55 this week ? not as a punishment, just to reset the pattern. Hit 10/10/10 at RPE 7 at 55, then we go to 60 with the full prescription met. Pull to the hip, full second squeeze at the top, slow the negative. Strap up if grip is the limiter.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: UP to 110 ? last week was clean: 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7. All three sets perfect, all at the top of the range, RPE never cracked 8. That earns the bump. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom. Stay upright through all three sets ? the tendency at 110 is to start rowing it down instead of pulling it down. Lats, not shoulders.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: UP to 70 ? last week 15/15/15 at RPE 7/7/7. Perfect across the board. Earned. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish. At 70 lbs this movement will start to get sloppy if you let it ? stay deliberate, elbows high, external rotation at the end of every rep. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 or under to earn 75.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: UP to 35 ? last week 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7. Clean. All three sets at the top of the range, all at RPE 7. That's a clear earn. Elbows pinned, neutral grip, full curl to shoulder height, slow 2-second negative. This is a 5 lb jump so you might land at RPE 8 on set 3 ? that's fine as long as the reps are still there. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 or under to earn 40.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Flye
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? replacing straight-arm pulldown this week. Straight-arm pulldown was its first baseline week last session and you put up a solid log. Rotating to reverse flye this week to hit the rear delts directly from a different angle ? bent-over, squeezing the shoulder blades at the top rather than driving a cable. Start at 15 lbs. Hinge at the hips, soft bend in the elbows, raise out to the sides until arms are parallel to the floor, squeeze shoulder blades together at the top. Aim for 10-12 at RPE 7. Log all three sets.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 165 ? leg day wasn't logged again. That's three consecutive weeks without a confirmed leg session. This is now a pattern, not a one-off. The plan hasn't changed because you haven't given it anything to work with. Whatever is happening on Fridays needs to get fixed this week. Get under the bar, hit 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 8 or under, and log it. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels. This is the third ask ? make it happen.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 145 ? no leg day log. Previous data was 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7, which already earned the bump to 155 on paper. But we can't move without a confirmed session. Show up Friday, replicate those numbers, and next week you get 155 no questions asked. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar tracks close to the legs on the way down, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom. Don't round the lower back.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? no leg day log. Last confirmed data had you stuck at 10 reps when the target is 12. Rear foot on the bench, drop straight down, front shin stays vertical, drive through the front heel. You have the strength to get past 10 ? you just need to commit to the last two reps instead of putting the dumbbells down early. Log each side separately.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Staying at 75 ? no leg day log. Last confirmed data was 12/12/10 at RPE 7/7/8. Two sets were clean and set 3 dropped. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 8 or under to earn 85. Upper back on the bench, drive through the heels, full hip extension at the top, hard squeeze for one full second. That third set is the only thing standing between you and a bump ? lock it in.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? replacing leg extension this week. Leg extension was in for two weeks with zero logged data ? we have nothing on it. Rotating to leg curl to make sure hamstrings get direct isolation work since RDLs are compound. Start at 45 lbs, baseline week. Curl the heels toward the glutes, full ROM, controlled on the way back down. Aim for 12-15 at RPE 7. Log what you actually used. If 45 is too easy or too hard, adjust and note it.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
exercises.notes: Staying ? still no data on this movement after three weeks. Forearms on the dip bar pads, raise knees to chest height, no swinging, control the descent all the way down. Aim for 10-12 at RPE 7-8. Bodyweight core work ? there's genuinely no excuse to skip the log on this one. Three sets, every rep counted, write it down.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
